title: Grace period for overdue
notes: P1 signature change. Invoice#daysOverdue gains a required parameter; its callers are Invoice#status, agingReport and remindersDue (three different files), plus the CLI aging command that has to pass the value through. The prompt names no file, so finding the callers is the planning. The reference touches src/invoice.js, src/aging.js, src/reminders.js and src/cli.js.
